question.text: An organic compound with molecular formula, <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>7</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>8</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> , dissolves in NaOH and gives characteristics colour with neutral <math><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">e</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> . On treatment with bromine-water, it gives a tribromo derivative, <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>7</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">B</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mo>.</mo></math> The compound is

solution.text:
The compound may be a phenol, because it gives characteristic colour with FeCl3 .

Only compound (II) can give tribromo-derivative.
